certs.name: CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701)
certs.role: Entry credential named in NZ graduate listings
certs.note: Training providers report SY0-801 launching around November 2026, with SY0-701 bookable until about June 2027. Confirm the version on CompTIA's site before booking.

certs.name: ISC2 CC (alternative to Security+)
certs.when: Instead of Security+, not as well
certs.note: The outline changed on 1 September 2026, and the free 1MCC programme closed to new enrolments in May 2026. Use study material written for the new outline.

certs.name: eJPT (INE)
certs.when: Phase 3, after web and pentest labs
certs.note: 48-hour hands-on lab exam. PJPT (TCM Security) is an Active Directory-focused alternative.

certs.name: Microsoft SC-200
certs.role: The cert that matches NZ SOC roles (Defender, Sentinel, KQL)
certs.note: Skills outline as of 21 October 2026: manage a security operations environment (40-45%), respond to incidents (35-40%), threat hunting (20-25%). Microsoft Learn's training path and practice assessment are free.

certs.name: Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1)
certs.role: Practical SOC and incident response credential
certs.note: 24-hour practical exam built around one connected incident. The provider renamed itself Centri in June 2026; the certification is unchanged.

certs.name: Microsoft SC-500 (replaced AZ-500)
certs.note: AZ-500 retired on 31 August 2026. SC-500 has been in beta since May 2026 and is aimed at working engineers.

certs.name: PNPT, then OSCP
certs.cost: A large investment; check OffSec and TCM pricing
certs.note: NZ pentest listings typically ask for 2-3 years' experience plus certs like these.
